rust_summary: a mod block entity writing what it holds now into its saved data before its chunk saves or a `/data` command reads it (`native_block_entity_save`).
doc_summary:
`native_block_entity_save(pos, entity)` asks a mod block entity to write what it holds now into its saved compound (`entity.nbt`), as vanilla's chunk saves each of its block entities (`saveWithFullMetadata`) and `/data` reads one: asked on the server for the mod block entities of the chunks about to be saved (the autosave, unloading, a dimension change, closing the world) and for the block a `/data` command reads. A block entity that writes its data only when it changed (`setChanged`) stays exact where it is read. Server-side.

Bundles that use it need `"hooks": @API:block_entity_save@`.
